title: v0.9.68 — Watch your garden grow

blocks.text: Planting now starts a visible harvest countdown: Mint Sprout takes 1 minute, Berry Bloom 3 minutes, and Moon Blossom 6 minutes. Fields and the restoration board show the remaining time. Crops continue growing while you are away or offline, and never wither.

The planting task stays active until you collect the harvest. Stage clears still give extra seeds, but no longer grow crops directly. Existing mature crops stay ready; partially grown crops keep their growth proportion as remaining time. We also fixed field taps that could stop responding after dragging the village. Combat stats and cottage costs are unchanged.
種下作物後會顯示收成倒數：薄荷嫩芽 1 分鐘、莓果花 3 分鐘、月光花 6 分鐘。田地與修復任務板都能看到剩餘時間；離開或離線仍會成長，成熟後不會枯萎。
領取收成後才完成種植任務。通關仍可獲得額外種子，但不再直接推進作物成長。舊版成熟作物保持可收成，半熟作物依原成長比例換算剩餘時間。另外修正拖動村莊後田地偶爾按了沒反應的觸控問題。戰鬥數值與修屋成本不變。

body_html:
English

Planting now starts a visible harvest countdown: Mint Sprout takes 1 minute, Berry Bloom 3 minutes, and Moon Blossom 6 minutes. Fields and the restoration board show the remaining time. Crops continue growing while you are away or offline, and never wither.

The planting task stays active until you collect the harvest. Stage clears still give extra seeds, but no longer grow crops directly. Existing mature crops stay ready; partially grown crops keep their growth proportion as remaining time. We also fixed field taps that could stop responding after dragging the village. Combat stats and cottage costs are unchanged.

繁體中文

種下作物後會顯示收成倒數：薄荷嫩芽 1 分鐘、莓果花 3 分鐘、月光花 6 分鐘。田地與修復任務板都能看到剩餘時間；離開或離線仍會成長，成熟後不會枯萎。

領取收成後才完成種植任務。通關仍可獲得額外種子，但不再直接推進作物成長。舊版成熟作物保持可收成，半熟作物依原成長比例換算剩餘時間。另外修正拖動村莊後田地偶爾按了沒反應的觸控問題。戰鬥數值與修屋成本不變。
